Required: Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 runtime for cosmetic loader
Optional: MetaHuman Creator Core Data and Epic sign-in
Setup: First run asks Play mods or Create mods. Complete Steam installations no longer need manual game-build approval. Prepared downloads set up the cosmetic runtime without Epic, Unreal, Blender or mapping capture. Creator setup discovers tools and guides official installer/sign-in steps.
DependencyStatus: ImageSharp 3.1.12 remains pinned with five advisories; bounded static PNG handoff. See DEPENDENCY-STATUS.md.
Note: Beta: automatic project-local Rowe Clothing plugin installation, verification and repair. Creator garment import, fit/weight transfer and viewer shaping controls. Exact Unreal build required; no compiler or manual plugin copy. Private tattoo tool excluded. Final mesh-estimated interactive positions and two-PC gameplay remain beta checks.

AutomaticUpdates.Apply: Automatically after current Studio task and painting finish; helper waits for game and Unreal closure, then relaunches Studio
AutomaticUpdates.LegacyRecovery: 0.2.77–0.2.81 installs whose old updater rejects their existing inventory need one complete-ZIP manual update, retaining the original workspace and artwork. Current stock portraits use accepted assets/brand paths.
AutomaticUpdates.MissingFileRepair: At the current published version, restore missing inventory-owned program files through the verified updater transaction; preserve modified files and user content.

MetaHumanSetup.ExactSizes: Read selected components in Epic Launcher Options
MetaHumanSetup.HardwareGuidance: Epic recommendations; not minimums or installation blockers
MetaHumanSetup.SkinDetails: Paused; no extension or local C++ build required

Workflow.Character: Save MetaHuman in Creator, then Build & launch game. Groom slots resolve through saved wardrobe selections and native groom bindings without loading a second Creator preview actor.
Workflow.Clothing: Open a character in Creator from Studio. Rowe Clothing installs automatically; import garment geometry, adjust placement and shape, Fit & rig, then select the saved wardrobe item. Garments remain fitted to this character.

CreatorRequired: Unreal Engine 5.8.3 for character assembly and game asset cooking
